what: A gate that moved a result also quietly dropped what was known about it. A licensing gate relocated a result to a rejected list but kept only its name and link, discarding every other fact — license evidence, version pin, compatible ranges — that had already been verified about it.
rule: A gate may move a result, but it must never drop the facts already gathered about it.
fix: Enforcement: a rejected result now keeps every field the original result carried, plus which gate moved it and why. Regression coverage is in `tests/wire-125.test.mjs`.
